name: Tadaima Jugyou Chuu!
source:
Female teacher tries to calm the class to no avail. She calls the leader for a private talk and acts in a seducing manner. When he returns for a supplement, he is required to become personal slave. Eventually boy gets tired of this game and confesses to her. She starts avoiding him resulting in depression. Eventually teacher agrees to date in form of a game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
